name: Clopidogrel
description: A thienopyridine prodrug that irreversibly blocks the platelet P2Y12 receptor, approved for acute coronary syndrome and recent myocardial infarction, stroke or established peripheral arterial disease. Carries a boxed warning for diminished effectiveness in CYP2C19 poor metabolisers.

systems.note: P2Y12 blockade reducing atherothrombotic events; the labelled indication.
Bleeding is the dose-limiting effect; thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura is labelled.
CYP2C19 activation is required; hepatic injury is documented.
